scenario.on_this_estate: CLAIM-UNDER-TEST.json pins the catalog [REDACTED] contract (local dispatcher, dynamic fan-out, no commit pre-flight). This box's MemAvailable exceeds commit headroom (overcommit heuristic). Calibration measures commit-per-worker then projects; it does not spawn 2048 processes.
procedure: 1. Read live /proc/meminfo (Committed_AS, CommitLimit, MemAvailable) and /proc process count.
2. Calibrate commit-per-worker with 4 short-lived 16MiB python workers; terminate them.
3. Evaluate the pre-flight for local fan-out=2048, local fan-out=4, worktree fan-out=2048, cloud fan-out=2048.
4. Assert MemAvailable > commit headroom (RAM view hides the bind) and estate_processes == 23*65.
5. Assert local/worktree 2048 is refused, cloud 2048 is allowed, local 4 is allowed (anti-vacuity).
6. Cite CLAIM-UNDER-TEST.json preflight line as the file:line that leaves local [REDACTED] ungated.
